maria_cs: Heads-up: Zenith onboarding showing embedding latency p99 breaches. Theyre worried about renewal impact and asked for credits math + remediation plan before Friday's exec review.

aj_devops: Which SLOs again? Ill map to our telemetry.

maria_cs: Contract lists uptime 99.9% monthly, p95 text-gen <=120ms, embedding p99 <=250ms. Embedding p99 is the flagged item.

aj_devops: Our metrics show embedding p99 ~280ms during peak bursts. Looks like small-batch cold KV-cache misses + occasional queueing.

pat_account: We need a concise customer note with remediation steps and a draft credit calculation. Finance will require minutes of breach and token throughput estimate.

aj_devops: Quick mitigations: 1) bump Dedicated burst capacity for Zenith, 2) enable persistent KV-cache warmers for their embedding traffic, 3) adjust client-side batching strategy. I can implement 1+2 as a short-term fix.

maria_cs: For the credit calc, I can pull breach windows from the dashboard. Early pull shows ~35m total across three peak days, avg tokens/sec ~12k during those windows. Will DM spreadsheet.

aj_devops: Draft remediation blurb for comms:

"What we observed: embedding p99 peaked at ~280ms vs contract 250ms during peak windows. Immediate actions: enable persistent KV-cache warmers and temporarily increase Dedicated burst capacity for 72 hours. Expected outcome: reduce p99 to ~200-230ms while we tune batching. Follow-up: engineering to run a 48-hour validation and share telemetry. If the SLO is missed next month, we will apply pro-rata credits per contract section 4.2."

pat_account: CS leadership wants an enablement runbook the customer ops team can use to self-serve. Aj, can you produce a 3-step runbook snippet we can share?

aj_devops: Yep. Example runbook lines to include:

# warm cache for embeddings
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warm-cache -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"embed-v1","prompts":["warm1","warm2"]}'

# increase burst capacity
redwoodctl capacity set --customer zenith --burst 2

maria_cs: I'll bundle the runbook, telemetry screenshot, and credit spreadsheet into a one-page comm and propose a 30-min remediation call.

pat_account: Add timeline note: finance needs 5 business days after telemetry validation to finalize credits.

maria_cs: Targeting comm out by EOD tomorrow. Remediation queued; follow-up validation in 72h. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T12:04:17Z finished for infra/kv-warmers (canary)

aj_devops: Canary deploy passed, will kick off warmers once we confirm with ops.

pat_account: I'll prepare a renewal slide summarizing actions and attach this thread as evidence.

maria_cs: Closing loop, DMing the spreadsheet now. Thanks everyone. :pray:
